reason: A persistent DSH Web inventory for organizing, searching, viewing, and reusing notes, prompts, links, files, images, and other items, with additional session-cost tracking and Agent retrieval tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供常驻的物品栏，用于整理、搜索、查看和复用笔记、提示词、链接、文件、图片及其他内容。
summaries.en: A persistent DSH Web inventory for organizing, searching, viewing, and reusing notes, prompts, links, files, images, and other content.

capabilities: Stores notes, prompts, links, files, images, commands, skills, and plugin references in a local inventory
Reads session logs to calculate token usage and costs
Provides search and retrieval through Agent tools and a local Web API
Accepts selected or dragged local files and renders stored content for viewing
